sources.title: TaskHandoff readme
sources.locator: Introduction; Current Scope; Features; Architecture; Server installation; Desktop application; Mobile releases
sources.finding: Documents a free self-hostable multi-node control plane, browser/Desktop/Mobile clients, Codex/OpenCode-only first-class kernels, Docker/Local runtimes and separately versioned release components.

sources.title: TaskHandoff packages/app-runtime/src/managed-app-definitions/codex/runtime.ts
sources.finding: CodexRuntimeExtension launches a shared codex app-server, binds a Unix or authenticated WebSocket listener and attaches TTY sessions through a per-session proxy.

sources.title: TaskHandoff packages/app-runtime/src/managed-app-definitions/opencode/runtime.ts
sources.finding: OpenCodeRuntimeExtension launches opencode serve on loopback with random credentials, waits for health and attaches terminals to the shared server.

sources.title: TaskHandoff apps/mobile/src/repository/RepositoryDiffView.tsx
sources.locator: RepositoryDiffView; SplitCodeLine; inline code line renderer
sources.finding: The mobile repository view renders actual before/after line.content through RepositoryCodeText, line numbers, addition/deletion markers and expandable context in split/inline views.

sources.title: TaskHandoff packages/control-plane-ui/src/apps/control-plane/story/StoryActionAutomations.vue
sources.finding: The Story automation interface lists schedules, effective status, next run, run-history sessions and run/enable/edit controls.

sources.title: TaskHandoff controlled-instance-rs/crates/workspace/src/triggers/schedule.rs
sources.finding: The controlled-instance trigger module calculates interval, daily and weekly due times with timezone validation.

sources.title: TaskHandoff controlled-instance-rs/crates/workspace/src/triggers/scheduler.rs
sources.finding: The controlled-instance scheduler admits or queues runs by cooldown, concurrency and busy policy, with a100-item per-trigger queue bound.

sources.finding: Main repository application/service code is Apache-2.0; component exceptions are not silently inferred from this root grant.
